_about: Station (maps_dict 31) in Free for All as Racket only in open rooms (the owner, 2026-11-27: "make it racket only"): srp's key mode.srp_twists_only = "racket" in its config, which the server reads (survarium maps::MapMode::open_play, twist::OpenPlay::Only): an open room's card on it is always FFA: Racket, never plain Free for All or another twist; a private room plays it plain, as its every free-for-all.
